::: {#def-large-language-model}

#### Large language model (LLM)

A **large language model**,
or **LLM**,
is a [language model](language-models.qmd#def-language-model) made of [Transformer block](attention-transformers.qmd#def-transformer-block)s,
with far more [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) than the networks of earlier chapters,
[pretrained](attention-transformers.qmd#def-pretraining) to predict the next token of a large collection of text.
No agreed size makes a language model large.

:::
